Well, it hasn't changed much. When you're trying to get a subverse off the ground, it's like talking to yourself. For awhile I was the only one posting things here. It wasn't daunting or anything, because I was doing it for myself. /v/Dreamworlds was a place where I could put otherworldly whimsical things I find, whether it would be 2D art, music, videos, stories, or whatever. I have collections on DeviantArt and ArtStation, and playlists on Plug.dj and Youtube, so I don't really need this place to keep track of the things I find. The purpose of this place was to share it publicly in a centralized location because I knew that there were people out there that would like to see it, I figured it was the right thing to do... that it was fair.

Now, even though we've only got ~3 regular posters, it's turned into a place where, instead of people discovering things that one person (me) has found, multiple people are sharing things they've found with others. At this point, the subverse is becoming what I've always intended it to be. The community is still a bit small, but I'm fine with that, I always have been. Ideally, I'd rather the community be more active than this — posting to conversation threads, hanging out in the music room, posting something every now and then — which will happen in the future as it continues to grow, and it will. So far the only advertising that's been done for this subverse was, I believe I made a post to /v/newsubverses/ awhile back, and this place was featured for about two weeks last month. That means that this subverse has been growing almost solely off accidental discovery and word of mouth.
